text: わたし　ケーキが　たべたいの　ミルフィーユを　おねがい！

structure.jp: ケーキが　たべたいの
structure.en: want to eat cake, you see

structure.jp: ミルフィーユを　おねがい！

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says you want to do it; the thing you want often takes が instead of を. ケーキが　たべたい = 'I want to eat cake'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement gives it a soft 'you see' feeling, and sounds feminine here. たべたいの = 'I want to eat, you see'.
